legal_name: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
topic: Skincare serum box RFQ buyer brief

buyer_wording_groups.likely_intent: The buyer needs a retail-ready box for serum or dropper bottle products.
buyer_wording_groups.route_note: Confirm bottle height, diameter, filled weight and whether an insert is required.

buyer_wording_groups.likely_intent: The buyer may need secondary packaging that protects a glass or PET dropper bottle.
buyer_wording_groups.route_note: Review bottle fit, neck clearance, insert structure and shipping protection before quoting.

buyer_wording_groups.likely_intent: The buyer is comparing cosmetic packaging options for a serum product line.
buyer_wording_groups.route_note: Route to the skincare serum box page first, then compare with the cosmetic packaging category if multiple formats are needed.

buyer_wording_groups.likely_intent: The buyer may want a folding carton, rigid box or box with tray depending on product value and retail channel.
buyer_wording_groups.route_note: Clarify whether the priority is cost control, shelf presentation, protection or premium unboxing.

buyer_wording_groups.likely_intent: The buyer is evaluating finish, structure and supplier process for a beauty brand project.
buyer_wording_groups.route_note: Prepare artwork status, finish reference and target market before requesting a sample review.

rfq_inputs: Bottle type, diameter, height and filled weight
Number of bottles or components per retail unit
